capabilities: Add command and open-file actions to the empty new-tab view
Group multiple actions into nested grouped actions shown in a suggester
Set custom icons and confirmation prompts per action
Register actions as new Obsidian commands, including renamed or modified existing commands
Hide default messages and buttons on the empty view via CSS
disambiguation: Not a homepage or custom new-tab dashboard; it only customizes the truly empty file view and explicitly does not provide custom views or notes.
extras: README warns the empty-file-view feature relies on undocumented Obsidian behavior and may break in future versions; it can be disabled via a setting to keep only the command features. A MaintenanceReport is referenced for version compatibility.
problem: Obsidian's empty new-tab view is static and offers no way to launch commands or open files directly from it.
summary: Adds configurable actions (run commands, open files, grouped actions) to Obsidian's empty new-tab view and can register them as commands.
